svg.aria-label: Normalizing the post's order sheet: orders_raw to 1NF (split lists into rows), 2NF (move columns that depend on order_id alone), 3NF (move columns that depend on another non-key column) ending in customers, suppliers, products, orders and order_lines

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Normalizing the order sheet, step by step

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each step moves columns that depend on the wrong thing. Highlights mark the problem the next step removes.
